fieldValues.title: An essay finds published packages and installs what it needs
fieldValues.move: An essay can see a list of published packages, what each one is for and what it would add, and install one with its dependencies. The writer does this from the editor, and a connected agent can read the same list and suggest an install, which the writer confirms. The list is an ext:registry catalog; the essay package keeps only what every kind of writing needs, and everything else arrives this way.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Publishing by groups outside this programme, trust and signing of third-party packages, subset export and binding (RFC-047, srs#871). Defining new types in an essay (exercise fafd9091). An agent installing without the writer's confirmation.
fieldValues.falsifier: A writer whose essay needs something the essay package lacks, such as a story's characters, cannot find and install it without leaving the editor or asking someone, or an install succeeds and the types are still unusable.
fieldValues.return_when: When a second package beyond essay has been installed into a real essay from the list, by a writer or through an agent.
